provider: Anthropic via OpenRouter, pinned, no fallback
initialRequest: I want to make a pet game, but I am not sure if players should rescue lost pets or battle with them. Help me choose what players actually do before building anything.
clearRequest: Create a solo pizza shop game. Customers order a pizza, I choose the toppings, bake and serve it, earn coins, and buy a faster oven. Cartoon style, no fighting or trading. Choose sensible defaults and ask no questions.
answerPolicy: Choose rescue, solo shelter care, coins and forest-path progression. Exclude combat, trading and offline decay. Delegate incidental choices. Bind exact answers to returned question IDs and save them before clarification.
semanticGates: Initial questions separate consequential decisions, with no duplicate genre question or technical setup burden.
Clarification selects concrete defaults, preserves every explicit mechanic and exclusion, and does not ask resolved choices again.
Each playtest action is something the player can do in a generated game, with observable outcomes and no object-placement or scripting step.
Plan preserves the full requested loop and binds the original request and answers. No game build or specification approval occurs.
Clear pizza request needs no questions, preserves the order/toppings/bake/serve/coins/oven loop and the user's exclusions.
stopPolicy: Stop after any provider, contract, semantic or budget failure. No automatic retry. Require a saved passing semantic review before each dependent stage.
accounting: Reserve exact requests before dispatch, include all historical outbound reservations, reconcile provider receipts and settled key balance. Never charge a known local refusal as provider usage.
authorization: Not approved. Requires a new authorization.json recording the user's explicit approval and this combined ceiling before any credential read or live command.
forecastLimit: Forecast uses compact synthetic prior replies. Actual request reservations can be larger. The per-request cumulative guard remains authoritative.
